criteria.requirement: Implement click.writing.write_if_changed(path,content,*,encoding="utf-8") returning whether actual write occurred. Compare final encoded bytes first; identical bytes preserve inode/mtime/mode exactly. Changed/new data is serialized before I/O, written to same-directory temporary, flushed/fsynced, mode preserved (0600 when new) then atomically replaced, with cleanup on failure. Support bytes and encoded text; reject invalid content and symlinks. Verify real CliRunner invocation; do not alter open_file defaults or promise compare-and-swap locking/parent-directory fsync durability.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
